events.verdict: Achiuwa (NYK) is last to make contact with the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Giddey (CHI) is in the paint for less than three seconds when he moves to imminently guard an opponent.
Bridges (NYK) moves alongside White's (CHI) path and marginal body contact occurs, prior to Bridges cleanly blocking the driving shot attempt.
McBride (NYK) and Dosunmu (CHI) pursue the loose ball and marginal body contact occurs, as both players meet at the same spot.
Achiuwa's (NYK) momentum carries his body out of bounds after he recovers the loose ball.
Vucevic (CHI) establishes himself in Bridges' (NYK) path, firms up and absorbs the marginal contact that occurs as he sets the pick on the perimeter.
Achiuwa (NYK) legally contests Ball's (CHI) jump shot attempt.
After White (CHI) dribbles the ball off of his own foot, the ball makes contact with Bridges' (NYK) leg before going out of bounds. CHI correctly maintains possession of the ball.
Bridges (NYK) gets to the height of the ball and cleanly blocks Vucevic's (CHI) shot attempt near the rim.
Towns (NYK) slides his hand across Buzelis' (CHI) upper body, which causes Buzelis to momentarily lose control of the ball.

As part of his shooting motion, Vucevic (CHI) brings his right leg forward towards Achiuwa (NYK) for balance during his shot attempt.  Achiuwa does not initiate contact with Vucevic's lower body, and the marginal contact is caused by Vucevic.

events.verdict: Towns (NYK) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Bulls.
Buzelis (CHI) legally contests McBride's (NYK) jump shot attempt.
Brunson (NYK) clamps and holds Ball's (CHI) arm, which affects his ability to pursue the rebound.
Ball (CHI) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Knicks.
Vucevic (CHI) legally contests Brunson's (NYK) jump shot attempt.
Achiuwa (NYK) makes contact with the ball, and with the part of Buzelis' (CHI) hand that is on the ball, which cleanly dislodges the ball from Buzelis.
Towns (NYK) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Bulls.
Shamet (NYK) legally contests Vucevic's (CHI) jump shot attempt.
